sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (76 marks)
items: 1. Define the terms speed, velocity and acceleration. (3 marks)
2. A car accelerates from rest to 20 m/s in 5 s. Calculate its acceleration. (3 marks)
3. Using the circuit diagram, state the reading on the ammeter when the switch is closed. (3 marks)
4. An object of mass 4 kg is lifted through a height of 5 m. Calculate the work done. (4 marks)
5. State Newton's three laws of motion. (6 marks)
6. A body falls freely from rest for 3 s. Calculate the distance it covers. (4 marks)
7. Distinguish between heat and temperature. (2 marks)
8. State two factors that affect the resistance of a conductor. (2 marks)
